messages:
alex: Heads-up — after the KV-prefetch toggle from yesterday, I'm seeing lots of tiny batch formation on g4-pool-a and a ~15% p50 regression on short prompts. Anyone else noticing decode-rate bucket drift?
maria: Yup. Spotted that in the nightly perf dash. The classifier is pushing more requests into the fast-decode bucket even though elapsed token decode is higher. Feels like our decode-rate estimate is stale.
jonathan: I ran a quick profiler this morning. KV hit-rate looks fine, but the queue sampler is cutting batches at 2-3 requests because token_budget target is being hit earlier. Attached snapshot:
```
# sample metrics
pool: g4-pool-a
interval: 60s
avg_batch_size: 2.4
avg_tokens_per_request: 18
decode_rate_bucket: fast (0.9 tok/ms)
token_budget_target: 32
observed_decode_ms_per_token: 1.6
```
alex: Oof — so decode_rate_bucket says fast but observed is slow -> mismatch causes token_budget underestimation and smaller batches.
priya: This smells like the classifier input features drifted (we changed prompt-trim rules). The length bucket boundaries were tuned for old prompt length distribution.
maria: Agreed. Quick mitigation: increase token_budget_target by 20% for the fast bucket and bump min_batch_wait from 6ms -> 10ms for that pool so we give batches time to form. Canary?
deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: redist-batcher-config v2026.3 -> g4-pool-a (canary 10%)
jonathan: I tested a local sim with bumped token_budget and larger min_wait; avg_batch_size rose to 4.7 and p50 came back ~8% under baseline for short prompts. No KV regressions.
alex: Nice. But long-term we should fix the classifier. Action items: (1) re-run classifier training with new prompt-trim feature + include observed_decode_ms as a label; (2) add an online bias correction: if observed_decode_ms > expected by 20% for 30s, auto-inflate token_budget for that bucket.
priya: I'll take (1). Plan: re-label 24h of traffic, train, and run A/B for 12h.
maria: I'll add the online bias correction as a lightweight admission policy change, feature-flagged. Quick patch should be low risk.
jonathan: I'll monitor KV metrics during canary and collect decode traces for the A/B. Also will run kernel-selection profiler to ensure we didn't regress kernel handoff for mid-lengths.
alex: Cool. Also let's add a small perf-run checklist to PRs touching prompt-trim or classifier inputs.
priya: noted. PR coming for retrain data pipeline. ETA EOD tomorrow.
maria: I'll flip the canary to 50% if no regressions by +30m.
alex: Thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary deploy succeeded: redist-batcher-config v2026.3 (10% -> queued)
jonathan: quick FYI — trace sample attached in thread (link) shows kernel hop at token 12 for these prompts, might be due to sequence padding differences. worth ensuring our kernel-selection keys include padded_length.
priya: good catch. will include padded_length as feature in the next training run.
alex: OK closing loop later today with perf numbers. If anyone sees tail jump, @here ping me directly.
